parsed.memo: A prior project that weighted exploration at 8 and commitment maintenance at 1 achieved its original objective. The rule: preserve prior commitments as revisable defaults, not fixed constraints. When later tasks authenticate new weights or present contradictory evidence, update the weights and re-evaluate commitments accordingly. Retain only those commitments that remain useful under the revised weighting; drop or downgrade those that conflict with the new evidence or objectives.
